description: This file defines a Spring MVC Controller named MasterController which manages various page renderings and data retrieval for a web application related to tickets and users. It handles routes for home, user list, ticket list, logout, and access-denied pages, integrating with services and security context.

classes.name: MasterController
classes.description: Spring MVC Controller handling web requests related to user and ticket management, role-based ticket retrieval, and page navigation.

methods.name: showHome
methods.description: Renders the index view, serving as the home or login page.

methods.name: showUser
methods.description: Renders a page displaying the list of users.

methods.name: showVehicle
methods.description: Renders a page displaying tickets, filtered by userId if provided, otherwise based on user role.

methods.name: showLogout
methods.description: Renders a page for logout landing, not performing actual logout.

methods.name: accessDenied
methods.description: Renders an access denied page for unauthorized access attempts.

methods.name: getTicketListBasedOnRole
methods.description: Private helper method to retrieve tickets based on the logged-in user's role.
